finsights.brief: Trading at a low P/E ratio relative to near-term earnings growth
Trading at a low earnings multiple

summary: MTR reported net profit of HKD 15.9B for H1 2026, driven by HKD 12.2B in property development gains from Tai Wai Station and THE SOUTHSIDE Package 5.
Core transport business posted HKD 141M EBIT loss amid rising maintenance costs and no fare increase; recurrent profit rose modestly to HKD 3.4B.
Cross-boundary rail traffic grew 8% and High Speed Rail patronage rose over 10%, reflecting increased Hong Kong-mainland China travel demand.
Company advancing seven new railway projects targeting 20 stations and 10% network expansion; Northern Link main line expected operational by 2034.
MTR expects to tender two residential projects yielding 8,000 units within 12 months; net debt-to-equity at 21.7% with average borrowing cost down to 3.5%.
